**What are you trying to do?**
The task or problem behind the request, and what gets in the way today.

**What would you like NetPad to do?**
How you picture it working.

**How do you handle it today?**
Any workaround you use now, if there is one.

**Does another tool do this?**
If LINQPad or another tool already has this, how does it work there? Links or screenshots help.
